info.title: Monica CRM API
info.description: REST API v1 for Monica CRM. All endpoints require a Bearer API token. Fields use snake_case. Token abilities (e.g. `contacts:read`) gate each operation; a token holding `*` is granted every ability.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search across first name, last name, nickname.

post.description: Requires ability `tasks:write`. Either `name` or `label` must be provided.
Requires ability `notes:write`. At least one of `url`, `title`, `content`, `external_id` is required, and `source`/`kind` must be a valid combination.

get.description: Returns the user that owns the API token. No specific ability is required beyond a valid token.

bearerAuth.description: Provide the API token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with `-` for descending (e.g. `-created_at`).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes a write operation safe to retry. Replaying the same key with the same request body returns the stored response with `Idempotent-Replay: true`. Reusing the key with a different body returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` (error_code 44).

RateLimitLimit.description: Request quota for the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the rate-limit window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (present on 429).

IdempotentReplay.description: Set to `true` when the response is a replay of a previously stored idempotent request.

IdempotencyConflict.description: Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request (error_code 44).

Error.description: Standard error envelope. `error_code` is a stable numeric code (e.g. 31 NOT_FOUND, 32 VALIDATION_ERROR, 34 RATE_LIMITED, 42 UNAUTHORIZED, 43 FORBIDDEN, 44 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT).

ExternalRecordCreate.description: At least one of `url`, `title`, `content`, `external_id` must be present. `source`/`kind` must form a valid combination.
